claims: Vanuatu is an archipelago nation of 83 volcanic islands in the South Pacific.
Vanuatu is located east of Australia.
The capital of Vanuatu is Port Vila.
Port Vila is located on Efate Island.
Vanuatu has a population of approximately 318,000 as of 2024.
Vanuatu gained independence in 1980.
Mount Yasur is a volcano on Tanna.
There is an underwater post office at Hideaway Island.
The people of Vanuatu are known as Ni-Vanuatu.
Over 100 local languages are spoken in Vanuatu.
Bislama is spoken in Vanuatu.
English is spoken in Vanuatu.
French is spoken in Vanuatu.
Vanuatu is a Y-shaped archipelago.
Vanuatu is located roughly 1,750 km east of Australia.
Vanuatu was known as the New Hebrides.
The islands of Vanuatu were jointly managed by Britain and France until 1980.
Vanuatu took the name Vanuatu upon gaining independence in 1980.
Vanuatu means 'Our Land Forever'.
According to the U.S. Department of State, Vanuatu has a Level 1: Exercise Normal Precautions advisory.
According to the U.S. Department of State, a passport is required for entry into Vanuatu.
According to the U.S. Department of State, an onward ticket is required for entry into Vanuatu.
According to the U.S. Department of State, proof of funds is required for entry into Vanuatu.
According to the U.S. Department of State, visas are not needed for stays under 30 days in Vanuatu.
Vanuatu is in the Pacific Ring of Fire.
